versions.content: Existence of DiagnosticSessionControl . diagnostic- Session The idea of modeling the sub-function of DiagnosticSessionControl by means of the reference DiagnosticSessionControl . diagnosticSession implies that the applicable DiagnosticSession already exists at the time when the given DiagnosticSessionControl is created. It is assumed that this will always be the case because the definition of Diagnos- ticSession s is part of laying the groundwork 3 for diagnostic communication.
